interpretation: In a within-cat comparison the M1 cat-score difference cancels; M1 is a fitted displayed-side intercept and cannot distinguish the two photos. Comparisons are predictive and not causal.
prior_exposure: G3 was not reserved at Stage 0; its outcomes overlap earlier analyses. This is not an independent confirmatory test.
uncertainty: Exploratory and unadjusted for multiplicity, conditional on fitted models and selection; shared known photos, cats, and respondents may still induce dependence.
